messages.author: dc06d729e023580a
messages.subject: Premium services
parts:
Hi all,

I'm thinking about offering a membership service for ggplot2.
Everything that is currently available for free would keeping being
available for free: I'll still keep contributing to the mailing list
and the documentation will still be freely available, but I'd like to
introduce new services that would help raise money to develop ggplot2
and related packages. 100% of proceeds would go to funding activities
that would improve ggplot2 and related packages - none of it would go
to me.

I'd really appreciated your feedback through the brief survey
available at http://hadley.wufoo.com/forms/ggplot2-premium-services/ -
this will help me judge whether or not it's worthwhile to do.

Thanks!

Hadley
